Interactive Game with a Simple Objective UNO Roboto comes with 108 game cards and an interactive robot figure that serves as the dealer. The objective is simple: try to get rid of your cards as quickly as possible to win the game. Each player is dealt seven cards from the deck varying in color, number, and symbol. UNO Roboto will call out the name of a player to go first. Players must try to match a card from their existing pile with the card on top of the discard pile. If they don't have a match, they have to take an additional card from the draw pile. Players whittle down their cards, and the first player with only one card left must shout "UNO" to win the game. Customizable Game Play Adds a Twist If you've ever played UNO, or even if you haven't, playing UNO Roboto is simple. Prior to beginning the game, players record their name into the robot's microphone for personalized play. Players can also record special house rules, such as "Recite the pledge of allegiance," or "Do the chicken dance" for the robot to call out randomly during the game. Make up your own house rule or choose one from the house rule cards. Unlike classic UNO, the robot will speak surprise commands at random, challenging players by name to perform certain tasks. The robot may tell you to trade your cards with another player, or instruct everyone to raise an arm, with the last person to do it forced to draw two cards. Fun, Ready-to-Play Game This interactive card game comes with everything you will need to play. Three AA batteries come ready to power the robot, and no other setup is required. The play set comes with realistic looking, stackable ice cream scoops in four "flavors," two sturdy wooden cones, and two scoopers. Designed for children ages three and up, this charming toy requires no batteries and no assembly, making it a refreshing inspiration for your children's imaginative play. Ice Cream Parlor Set Ages: 3+ What We Think Fun factor: Durability: Educational factor: Novelty factor: The Good : Toy offers sturdy construction that's versatile enough to last several years. The Challenging : We wish there were more pieces for easier group play; also, the wooden cones are a bit heavy for younger children. In a Nutshell : Realistic ice cream cone playset offers plenty of inspiration for a child's imaginative play. Make a yummy, triple-scoop cone creation with the Ice Cream Parlor Set from Melissa & Doug. View larger . This simple, delicious-looking toy is fun and helps develop motor skills. View larger . Scoop 'N' Stack The Melissa & Doug Ice Cream Set features an abundance of nostalgic ice cream parlor charm, starting with its sturdy red-and-white, striped storage container. The set includes four realistic molded plastic ice cream scoops in chocolate, vanilla, strawberry, and mint chocolate chip "flavors." Two wooden cones and two plastic scoopers with painted wooden handles round out the set. The scoopers, cones, and four ice cream scoops are all magnetic, so the scoopers can actually pick up the ice cream scoops and place them on the cones. They easily release by pressing the lever, like a real ice cream scooper. Magnets in the cones keep the scoops in place, even with a quadruple-dipped cone. (All magnets are located on the interior of the pieces, so there's no danger of the magnets breaking off and posing a serious risk to small children.) Almost Good Enough to Eat This set carries realistic, authentic touches, from the classic ice cream scoopers to the waffle design on the wooden cones. The cones look so good that our child tester almost fooled an adult into thinking her cone was real. With its simple design and sturdy build, the Melissa & Doug Ice Cream Set gives children ideal props to inspire their imaginations -- no batteries, bells, or whistles to limit the possibilities. The toy can also aid in developing motor skills every time a young child uses the ice cream scooper to stack and balance the scoops. But it's a toy that older children will enjoy, too. The toy's sturdy, quality construction helps ensure that it will last through many years of play. Because it comes with two scoopers, this toy is ideal for group play, although some testers wished that the set had a few more pieces. history.item_name: Jan van Haasteren Ceaco Crowd Pleasers Collection Candy Factory Puzzle (1000 Piece) Toys & Games 1000 puzzle pieces High gloss image on package for reference Measures 27" x 20" when complete Collect all styles in the crowd pleasers collection! Proudly made in the USA Johannes (Jan) van Haasteren was born in 1936 in a small town near Rotterdam, Holland. As soon as Jan began to hold a pencil, he became hooked on drawing. He attended the Academy of arts in Rotterdam for drawing and the Academy of arts to study publicity and advertising. When he was asked to co-produce a comic strip, his world of comic strip drawing began. In the 1980S, along with his career in poster illustration, Jan began illustrating images for the Dutch toy Company, jumbo, which continues to this day. Still going strong at age 73, Jan is in his attic Studio daily, drawing the puzzle images which Ceaco proudly produces.
